clos.original_description: Understand core concepts, differences, and relationships among MLOps, DevOps, DataOps, and LLMOps (including RAG & Prompt Engineering basics); apply cloud architecture patterns for ML systems (ingestion, storage, deployment models) across major cloud platforms (AWS SageMaker, Azure ML, Vertex AI).
clos.enriched_description: Understand the relationships among MLOps, DevOps, DataOps, and LLMOps, including cloud impacts, production challenges such as drift and cost spikes, MLOps maturity models, and cloud ML product lifecycles. Apply cloud architecture patterns for ML project scoping, data, modeling, deployment, monitoring, baselines, SLO/SLI, budgeting, and deployment patterns across cloud platforms.

clos.original_description: Design and implement cloud-based data engineering pipelines using cloud-native services (AWS Lambda/Step Functions/Glue, GCP Dataflow/Cloud Composer, Azure Data Factory) and implement feature store management solutions (Feast, Vertex/Azure Feature Store) for offline/online inference.
clos.enriched_description: Design and implement cloud-based data engineering pipelines and feature management solutions for ML systems. The mapped scope includes cloud ML lifecycle components such as data lakes, warehouses, clusters, serving infrastructure, and static versus dynamic training patterns, while the CLO also names AWS Lambda, Step Functions, Glue, GCP Dataflow, Cloud Composer, Azure Data Factory, Feast, and cloud feature stores.

clos.original_description: Apply experiment tracking tools (MLflow, WandB, SageMaker Experiments, Vertex Vizier) and data versioning principles using DVC with cloud remotes (S3/GCS/Azure) to ensure reproducibility, data lineage, and metadata management in ML experiments.
clos.enriched_description: Apply experiment tracking tools (MLflow, WandB, SageMaker Experiments, Vertex Vizier) and data versioning principles using DVC with cloud remotes (S3/GCS/Azure) to ensure reproducibility, data lineage, and metadata management in ML experiments.

clos.original_description: Apply Docker containerization best practices, build containerized MLOps pipelines to deploy to cloud registries (ECR/GCR/ACR) and services (Cloud Run, ECS, GKE, AKS), and implement model serving patterns (TF Serving, FastAPI, Flask) with progressive delivery (blue-green, canary) and autoscaling (HPA/VPA).
